blocks.text: 1. Fast R-CNN
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785445607063-315083451.png

R-CNN, the previous topic, suffered from a genuinely severe speed problem, running a full network separately for every region. Fast R-CNN directly addresses R-CNN's own speed problem, explored throughout this topic.
It runs the Convolutional Neural Network once per image, not once per region proposal, a genuinely direct, targeted fix covered in complete depth throughout the rest of this topic.
2. Recapping The Problem Being Solved

This connects back to the speed problem and redundant computation, both already covered in R-CNN. R-CNN's own genuinely severe slowness came from running a full network separately for every single region.
Fast R-CNN genuinely eliminates that redundancy directly, a genuinely targeted fix that addresses exactly the bottleneck already covered as R-CNN's own most significant limitation.
3. Shared Feature Computation
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785445607064-824756335.png
This connects back to Feature Maps, already covered in the CNN module. Fast R-CNN genuinely computes feature maps for the entire image just once, a genuinely single, shared computation.
This holds rather than recomputing genuinely similar features separately for every overlapping region, already covered as R-CNN's own waste, directly eliminating that genuinely redundant computation.

blocks.text: 4. Region Of Interest Pooling
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785445607064-229844060.png

Fast R-CNN's genuinely key new technique connects back to Pooling, already covered in its own topic. Region of Interest Pooling extracts a genuinely fixed-size feature representation for each region, directly from the shared feature map.
This directly reuses the pooling concept already covered there, adapted specifically for extracting per-region features from one genuinely shared, whole-image feature map.
5. Why A Fixed Size Genuinely Matters
This connects back to fully connected layers, already covered in Network Architecture. Fully connected layers genuinely need a fixed-size input, already covered as a real requirement there.

Region of Interest Pooling, already covered in this topic, genuinely guarantees that fixed size regardless of a region's own original shape, since candidate regions naturally come in many different sizes and aspect ratios.

blocks.title: info
blocks.content: This fixed-size guarantee, already covered in this topic, is exactly what lets regions of genuinely wildly different shapes and sizes all feed into the exact same fully connected layers already covered in Network Architecture.

blocks.text: 6. A Single Forward Pass
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785445607065-980356225.png
This connects back to R-CNN's own thousands of separate network runs, already covered. Fast R-CNN genuinely needs just one single forward pass through the shared network per image.
This is a genuinely dramatic speedup directly resulting from the shared feature computation already covered in this topic, transforming thousands of separate runs into just one.
7. The Benefit Of Joint Training
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785445607065-865514650.png

This connects back to bounding box regression, already covered in R-CNN. Fast R-CNN genuinely trains classification and box regression together, in one unified network, rather than as separate stages.

This holds rather than R-CNN's own genuinely separate, disjointed training stages, already covered there, letting both tasks genuinely inform and improve each other during a single, unified training process.

blocks.text: 8. A Remaining Bottleneck
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785445607066-2009410.png

A genuinely important, remaining limitation connects back to the region proposal stage, already covered in R-CNN. Fast R-CNN genuinely still relies on that same, genuinely separate, slower region proposal algorithm.

This means Fast R-CNN, despite every improvement already covered throughout this topic, still has a genuinely real speed bottleneck outside the neural network itself, motivating the very next topic in this module.
9. Recognizing Why Fast R-CNN Is Genuinely A Meaningful Improvement

10. Worked Example

The example below directly demonstrates Fast R-CNN's own conceptual pipeline in code, contrasting its single shared feature computation against R-CNN's own repeated computation already covered in the previous topic.

code.content:
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.RandomState(42)

def compute_full_image_features(image_size, rng):
    # already covered as shared feature computation in this topic: computed just once
    return rng.normal(size=(image_size // 16, image_size // 16, 256))

def roi_pool(feature_map, region_box, output_size=7):
    # already covered as Region of Interest Pooling in this topic: fixed-size output regardless of region shape
    return np.zeros((output_size, output_size, feature_map.shape[-1]))  # a genuinely simplified stand-in

image_size = 224
shared_features = compute_full_image_features(image_size, rng)  # computed once, already covered in this topic
print(f"Shared feature map shape (computed just once): {shared_features.shape}")

region_proposals = [(10, 10, 100, 100), (50, 50, 180, 200), (0, 0, 224, 224)]
for i, box in enumerate(region_proposals):
    pooled = roi_pool(shared_features, box)  # already covered as Region of Interest Pooling in this topic
    print(f"Region {i + 1} at {box}: pooled feature shape {pooled.shape}, genuinely fixed regardless of the region's own original size")

blocks.content: Running this example shows the shared feature map computed exactly once, then reused across every region via Region of Interest Pooling, exactly the efficiency gain already covered as this topic's own core improvement over R-CNN.

blocks.text: 11. Key Takeaways

items: Fast R-CNN runs the Convolutional Neural Network once per image, not once per region proposal.
It directly eliminates R-CNN's redundant, per-region computation.
It computes feature maps for the entire image just once, shared across every region.
Region of Interest Pooling extracts a fixed-size feature representation for each region.
A fixed size is required because fully connected layers need consistent input dimensions.
It needs just one single forward pass through the shared network per image, a dramatic speedup.
It trains classification and box regression together, in one unified network.
It still relies on a genuinely separate, slower region proposal algorithm, a remaining bottleneck.
Next up: Faster R-CNN, which directly addresses that exact remaining bottleneck.
